remarks: Tucked away on a private drive just moments from the Wilton border, this inviting 3 bedroom/2 bath home offers a rare blend of convenience and quiet retreat. Freshly painted with newly refinished hardwood floors throughout.  Ideally located, with easy access to Wilton, Westport and Norwalk, as well as train stations, shopping, restaurants, and local activities, yet the setting feels like a world apart. Enjoy glimpses of the Long Island Sound in the distance along with the gentle sounds of nature that make this setting so unique. A rare opportunity to enjoy both convenience and a private, natural setting.
